questions.question: If 3:4 = x:20, find x.
questions.explanation: Set up proportion: 3/4 = x/20. Cross-multiply: 3 × 20 = 4 × x ⇒ 60 = 4x ⇒ x = 15.

questions.question: A recipe for 6 servings uses 2 cups of flour. How much flour for 9 servings?
questions.explanation: Set up proportion: 2/6 = x/9. Cross-multiply: 2 × 9 = 6 × x ⇒ 18 = 6x ⇒ x = 3.
questions.fastStrategy: Set up ratios of corresponding quantities.

questions.question: Two quantities are in the ratio 5:7. If the first is 20, what is the second?
questions.explanation: Ratio 5:7 means 5/7. If first is 20: 5/7 = 20/x ⇒ 5x = 140 ⇒ x = 28.

questions.question: If y is directly proportional to x and y = 12 when x = 3, find y when x = 8.
questions.explanation: Direct proportion: y = kx. Find k: 12 = k(3) ⇒ k = 4. So y = 4x. When x = 8: y = 4(8) = 32.
questions.fastStrategy: Direct proportion: y = kx; find k from one data point.
